sentences.en: Alchemists tried to transmute base metals into gold and silver.
sentences.zh: 炼金术士试图将贱金属转化为金银。

sentences.en: Alchemists tried to turn base metals such as lead into gold.
sentences.zh: 炼金术士试图把铅等贱金属变成黄金。

sentences.en: The alchemists wanted to turn lead into gold.
sentences.zh: 炼金术士想要把铅变成黄金。
